summary:
The [Association for Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education](https://www.aashe.org/) (AASHE), a nationwide association of higher education staff and stakeholders focused on improving higher education’s environmental impact. CCCC is supporting planning for the student networking session at the 2026 AASHE annual conference.
The Harvard Kennedy School Institute of Politics's [Program for Environmental Politics](https://iop.harvard.edu/programs/program-environmental-politics), a student-led and staff-supported initiative (learn more [here](https://iop.harvard.edu/programs/program-environmental-politics)). CCCC currently is supporting planning for a Fall 2026 forum.
[Student Sustainability Leadership Symposium](https://sustainability.tufts.edu/get-involved/students/opportunities-beyond-tufts/ssl-symposium/) (SSLS), an annual student-led event that brings together students interested in sustainability throughout the Northeast to highlight and support student leadership in sustainability. CCCC is currently helping plan the 2026 SSLS.
